title: Projective-line diagonal trace, chart pushforward and alpha
statement: Keep $S$, $q:P=\mathbf P^1_S\to S$, $W=P\times_SP$, the projections $p_a$ and charts $e_a:\mathbf P^1_P\cong W$ with $p_ae_a=r:\mathbf P^1_P\to P$ of [def-sp-p1-diagonal-charts], and the ordinary finite-coefficient categories, direct images and normalized twist transports of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. (1) The chart pushforward $J_a:R(p_a)_*A_W(1)[2]\to Rr_*A_{\mathbf P^1_P}(1)[2]$ is the composite of $R(p_a)_*$ of the unit of $e_a^{-1}\dashv R(e_a)_*$, the derived-composition comparison $R(p_a)_*R(e_a)_*\cong R(p_ae_a)_*$, the identification $p_ae_a=r$, and $Rr_*$ of the normalized shifted-twist comparison $e_a^{-1}A_W(1)[2]\cong A_{\mathbf P^1_P}(1)[2]$ for the canonical transport of [def-amb-p1-trace]. (2) For $S$ Noetherian with $N$ invertible, the diagonal trace is $t_{p_a}=t_r\circ J_a$, with $t_r$ the projective-line trace of [def-amb-p1-trace] over the Noetherian base $P$; this factorization is recorded as a lemma. (3) $\alpha_a:A_P\to R(p_a)_*R\Delta_*A_P$ is the composite of the two constant-object units of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system] for $p_a$ and $\Delta$. The trace and alpha definitions keep the signatures they had in the item module.

lean.statement:
def projectiveLineDiagonalTrace (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (a : Bool) :
    (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projectiveLineDiagonalProjection S a)).obj
      ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ⟶
      ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S)
lean.note: projectiveLineDiagonalTrace and projectiveLineDiagonalAlpha moved unchanged from the item module; projectiveLineDiagonalChartPushforward (moved here by the reviewer from the Chern-components module) is the trace's prefix, and projectiveLineDiagonalTrace_eq records the factorization through projectiveLineTrace.
